developer.match: Match each game to the studio that made it.
developer.odd: Three of these were made by {value}. Which one wasn't?

rows.label: Wordle
rows.hook: has everyone guessing a hidden five-letter word in six tries, sharing colored-square results online

rows.label: Roblox
rows.hook: lets millions of players build and publish their own games inside one shared platform

rows.label: World of Warcraft
rows.hook: lets thousands of players raid dungeons together in a persistent fantasy realm for a monthly fee

rows.label: Fortnite
rows.description: 2017 video game developed by Epic Games
rows.hook: drops a hundred players onto a shrinking island to be the last one standing, building forts along the way

rows.label: Spider-Man
rows.description: 2018 video game developed by Insomniac Games
rows.hook: lets you swing between skyscrapers as a wall-crawling superhero protecting a city

rows.label: Final Fantasy VII
rows.hook: follows a mercenary who joins rebels fighting a company that drains the planet of its life energy

rows.label: Pac-Man
rows.hook: has you gobble dots and fruit through a maze while dodging four colorful ghosts

rows.label: Genshin Impact
rows.hook: lets you gacha-pull elemental heroes to explore a gorgeous open fantasy world

rows.label: Black Myth: Wukong
rows.description: 2024 video game developed by Game Science
rows.hook: follows a stone monkey hero fighting his way across a mythical land based on a classic legend

rows.label: League of Legends
rows.description: 2009 multiplayer online battle arena video game
rows.hook: pits two five-champion teams against each other to destroy a base guarded by turrets and a dragon pit

rows.label: PUBG: Battlegrounds
rows.hook: parachutes a hundred players onto an island to scavenge weapons until one team survives

rows.label: Super Mario Bros.
rows.hook: introduced side-scrolling platforming where a mustachioed plumber stomps turtles to rescue a princess

rows.label: Among Us
rows.hook: has a crew of colorful crewmates hunting for impostors secretly sabotaging their spaceship

rows.label: RuneScape
rows.hook: lets you level up a fantasy character in a browser-based medieval world that never resets

rows.label: Counter-Strike 2
rows.hook: has two five-player teams plant or defuse a bomb using realistic weapon recoil and round-based economy

rows.label: Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos
rows.hook: has four fantasy factions, including undead and elves, battle for territory with hero units leading armies

rows.label: Final Fantasy X
rows.hook: follows an athlete swept into a strange land where he joins a summoner's pilgrimage to stop a rampaging beast

rows.label: Portal
rows.hook: has you punch portals into walls to solve physics puzzles while a sarcastic AI mocks you

rows.label: Super Mario 64
rows.description: 1996 three-dimensional platform video game developed by Nintendo
rows.hook: was among the first platformers to let a mustachioed hero run freely through fully three-dimensional worlds

rows.label: Super Mario Odyssey
rows.hook: has a mustachioed hero throw a sentient, living hat to possess enemies and objects

rows.label: Valorant
rows.description: 2020 free-to-play multiplayer first-person shooter video game developed by Riot Games
rows.hook: has two five-player teams of gifted agents with unique powers plant or defuse a bomb on colorful maps

rows.label: Call of Duty
rows.hook: drops you into gritty modern and historical battlefields for fast-paced military shootouts

rows.label: Super Mario Galaxy
rows.hook: has a mustachioed hero hop between tiny spherical planets, bending gravity as he goes

rows.label: StarCraft
rows.hook: has three alien factions clash for territory in a legendary real-time strategy war

rows.label: Myst
rows.hook: strands you on a mysterious island of puzzles with no instructions and barely any dialogue

rows.label: Dota 2
rows.hook: pits two five-hero teams against each other to slay a boss and destroy a heavily shielded base

rows.label: Pong
rows.hook: has two players bat a bouncing square between paddles on opposite sides of the screen

rows.label: Euro Truck Simulator 2
rows.description: 2012 vehicle simulation video game made by SCS Software
rows.hook: has you haul cargo across a continent behind the wheel of a big rig

rows.label: Final Fantasy XII
rows.hook: follows a band of unlikely rebels fighting to free a conquered kingdom from an occupying empire

rows.label: Five Nights at Freddy's
rows.hook: has you survive night shifts guarding a haunted pizza restaurant from animatronic mascots

rows.label: Second Life
rows.hook: lets residents build homes, businesses, and avatars inside a persistent user-made virtual world

rows.label: Space Invaders
rows.hook: has you defend the bottom of the screen from descending rows of aliens closing in

rows.label: Cuphead
rows.hook: has you battle wildly animated bosses in a run-and-gun styled after old rubber-hose cartoons

rows.label: Brawl Stars
rows.hook: pits small teams of quirky characters against each other in quick top-down arena brawls

rows.label: Super Mario World
rows.description: 1990 platform video game developed by Nintendo
rows.hook: introduced a friendly dinosaur sidekick a mustachioed hero could ride and flutter-jump with

rows.label: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind
rows.hook: drops you into an open fantasy island province where you can ignore the main quest entirely

rows.label: Rocket League
rows.hook: is soccer played by jet-boosted cars smashing a giant ball into goals

rows.label: Tomb Raider
rows.description: 1996 action-adventure video game developed by Core Design
rows.hook: has an adventurer with twin pistols swing and climb through ancient booby-trapped tombs

rows.label: Final Fantasy VIII
rows.hook: follows a young mercenary swept into a war against a sorceress bent on manipulating time itself

rows.label: Final Fantasy IX
rows.hook: follows a monkey-tailed thief who kidnaps a princess and ends up saving the world with her instead

rows.label: Mario Kart 8
rows.hook: has drivers hurl shells and bananas at each other while racing go-karts around themed tracks

rows.label: Candy Crush Saga
rows.hook: has you match colorful candies in rows to clear boards on a never-ending map of levels

rows.label: Overwatch
rows.hook: has two teams of colorful heroes with unique powers fight over objective-based battlefields

rows.label: Cities: Skylines
rows.hook: lets you zone, pave, and manage traffic while growing a city from a small town

rows.label: Warcraft: Orcs & Humans
rows.hook: launched a legendary real-time strategy series pitting two fantasy armies against each other for territory

rows.label: War Thunder
rows.description: 2012 vehicular combat multiplayer video game developed by Gaijin Entertainment
rows.hook: lets you pilot tanks, ships, and warplanes together in large-scale historical combat

rows.label: Need for Speed: Underground 2
rows.hook: lets you deeply customize your car's body and paint before racing through a nighttime city

rows.label: Wii Sports
rows.hook: had players swing a motion controller like a racket or club to compete in the living room

rows.label: Civilization VI
rows.hook: has you guide a growing society from the stone age to the space age one turn at a time

rows.label: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves
rows.hook: has a wisecracking treasure hunter climb, shoot, and swing through cinematic set pieces

rows.label: Angry Birds
rows.description: puzzle video game by Rovio released in December 2009
rows.hook: has you slingshot squabbling flightless fowl at pigs who stole their eggs

rows.label: The Sims
rows.hook: lets you build a house and control the daily lives of little people in a dollhouse-like simulation
